settings.vitalsNote: Walasa ka siti teliya lɔn, i ka browser bɛ se ka teliya sumanni dɔw ci k'a sɔrɔ i tɛ jira: ɲɛ suguya (a adirɛsi abada) ani waati sumanni dɔɔnin. Foyi tɛ i jira, ani don o don jate dafalenw dɔrɔn de bɛ mara, tile 90. Do Not Track wala Global Privacy Control b'a faga.
